title: The Metacognitive Bottleneck: Japanese Riddles Reveal Fundamental Limits of Machine Insight and Self-Evaluation in Reasoning AI
abstract: arXiv:2509.14704v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Benchmark saturation and training-data contamination increasingly obscure whether reported gains in large language models (LLMs) reflect genuine advances in reasoning or familiarity with recurring patterns in benchmark problems. We introduce the NazoNazo Benchmark, a renewable and extensible evaluation dataset derived from Japanese children's riddles that isolates a specific class of reasoning processes: insight-like representational restructuring and metacognitive evaluation. Rather than modeling reasoning in general, these tasks provide a focused test of failure modes that are difficult to detect in standard benchmarks. We curate 201 riddles and establish a human reference on a 120-item subset (n = 126; mean accuracy 52.9%). The benchmark is fully open, low-cost to refresh, and designed for continual evaluation under reduced contamination risk. translated_title: 元认知瓶颈：日本谜语揭示推理型人工智能中机器洞察力与自我评估的根本局限
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.14704v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：基准测试饱和与训练数据污染日益掩盖了大型语言模型（LLMs）报告的性能提升是反映了推理能力的真正进步，还是对基准问题中重复模式的熟悉。我们引入了NazoNazo基准，这是一个可更新、可扩展的评估数据集，源自日本儿童谜语，它隔离了一类特定的推理过程：类似洞察的表征重构和元认知评估。这些任务并非泛化建模推理，而是提供了一个聚焦测试，针对标准基准中难以检测的失败模式。我们整理了201个谜语，并在120个条目的子集上建立了人类参考（n=126；平均准确率52.9%）。该基准完全开放，刷新成本低，并设计用于在降低污染风险下进行持续评估。我们评估了38个前沿LLM（2023-2025年），采用严格的免检索、零样本协议。
tldr: 该论文提出NazoNazo基准，基于日本谜语，专门测试推理AI在洞察式表征重构和元认知评估上的根本局限，揭示现有LLM在这些任务上的表现远低于人类水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the NazoNazo benchmark, based on Japanese riddles, specifically testing fundamental limits of insight-like representational restructuring and metacognitive evaluation in reasoning AI, showing frontier LLMs perform far below human levels on these tasks.
